page_title: AST 2-0 WOL | Aston Villa v Wolves 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Substitution. Leon Bailey walks off the pitch and Kaine Kesler Hayden (Aston Villa) comes on as a substitute.
90+6' The referee shows a yellow card to Lucas Digne (Aston Villa). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+6' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Wolves manage to earn a corner.
90+5' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) commits a foul during an attacking move. A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
90+4' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+2' The free kick is taken by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), but ball is cleared.
90+1' Toti (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul after Toti (Wolves) hacks down one of his opponents. That's a free kick to Aston Villa.
88' Substitution. Moussa Diaby leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa).
87' Matt Doherty (Wolves) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Santiago Bueno, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
84' Here comes a substitution. Joao Gomes is given a rest as he is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
84' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Leon Chiwome will be replaced by Nathan Fraser (Wolves).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Matt Doherty (Wolves) coming on for Nelson Semedo.
84' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
84' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Max Kilman (Wolves).
83' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' Handball by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa). It's a free kick to Wolves, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
81' Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
80' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa reads it well and gathers the ball.

80' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.

79' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.

79' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
78' The corner from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is hurriedly cleared.

74' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
73' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
73' It seemed like Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
71' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Thomas Doyle and he is replaced by Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves).

69' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Jose Sa, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
65' 2 - 0 GOAL! Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Jose Sa, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:0.
64' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
64' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan Ait-Nouri.
63' A substitution has been made. Alex Moreno goes off and Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) comes on.
63' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) replaces Morgan Rogers.
63' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
60' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) tries to find Jhon Duran, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
58' Toti (Wolves) commits a foul and Paul Tierney immediately signals a free kick. A free kick to Aston Villa.
58' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

56' Mario Lemina (Wolves) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
56' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Wolves will take a free kick.

52' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
50' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) was too forceful with his tackle and Paul Tierney interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Wolves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
49' Fine play by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
47' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) reacts quickest to a cross from Leon Bailey, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
47' Aston Villa have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Unai Emery gives a chance to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) and Ollie Watkins is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Paul Tierney has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
41' Paul Tierney interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa). A free kick is awarded to Wolves.
40' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

39' The game is interrupted. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Aston Villa will take a free kick near the side line.
36' 1 - 0 Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has reason to celebrate! His first-time shot from the edge of the area goes into the middle of the net and past the goalkeeper. 1:0.

36' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paul Tierney has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Free kick. Aston Villa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
35' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
33' What a save from Jose Sa! Pau Torres (Aston Villa) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
33' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes the corner with a short pass.
32' The ball is cleared after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Now Aston Villa have a corner.
30' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
28' Youri Tielemans slides a brilliant pass into Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
27' Paul Tierney interrupts the game. One of the players from Aston Villa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.

26' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

22' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

17' Max Kilman (Wolves) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
17' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.

14' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez reacts superbly to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
9' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Aston Villa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Aston Villa will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
6' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
5' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but it's cleared.
5' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
4' A player from Aston Villa commits a rough challenge. Paul Tierney blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Wolves have a free kick.
3' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will supervise the game today.
